capabilities: pair folders with same-named notes and manage them as complete nodes
browse node children, media, and files in a sidebar
visualize the node hierarchy in 2D or 3D graphs
create nodes from selected text or unresolved links
reorder, merge, hide, and migrate nodes with preview-first safeguards
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.12.7+; supports desktop and Android (no HTML5 drag-and-drop on Android), iOS unverified. Runs locally with no network requests and includes detailed merge-safety and privacy documentation.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer shows folders and notes as separate items, with no way to navigate a hierarchy of folder-plus-note units or see their structure in a graph.

relations.evidence: Use a picture from your vault, a Lucide icon, a letter, emoji or a color.

summary: Pairs each folder with a same-named note as a managed node, adding a contents sidebar, hierarchy graph, icons, ordering, and node-level actions.
